I made this subverse to share my not so secret passion for awful food cringe videos. There are a lot of youtubers that start up "cooking" or "food review" channels without actually having any skill or expertise, and its a goldmine of terrible videos. Here are a few of my favorite channels I would like to share with you.

  • Joeys world tour is the documentation of a sad downward spiral, featuring a man with no self respect or dignity. He regularly sits in his car and reviews fast food. The light in his eyes drains with each new video.

  • Cookies Cupcakes and cardio is run by a woman who barely does any cardio and bakes very thick overly decadent cakes. Unlike everyone else on this list, she has some actual skill and puts a genuine effort into her videos, she just doesnt know when to stop. Another layer of cake and icing, more chocolate, more sprinkles, more everything. She sabotages her recipes with thick batter and a large stomach. Some of her content is actually bearable though.

  • Simply Sarah is a morbidly obese southern woman who cooks disgusting, sugary, fatty foods. Her channel has been inactive since she allegedly caught pneumonia and had a long hospital stay. I am not aware any new content of hers, but she is definitely a classic for the uninitiated.

  • Cooking with Jack features an obese american man who insists on constantly wearing a yellow cap backwards. He has very little skill with cooking, even though he has had his cooking channel for years. He is overly optimistic, often insisting that all his food, even uncooked chicken is "juicy" or "perfect". Almost all of his videos are a goldmine of terrible cooking.

these are the basic channels that I enjoy watching for their terrible food related qualities, and I hope you can enjoy not enjoying them with me.
